properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH module of the bundled libsecp256k1 (src/secp256k1/src/modules/ecdh/, include/secp256k1_ecdh.h): sites are CI build-matrix flags (.cirrus.yml 'ECDH: yes' enables the module for test builds) and the module's own benchmark harness. The algorithms ship in the vendored library whether or not the node calls them; no application call site found in the node itself. secp256k1 ECDH is Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 single-block and CBC wrappers of the vendored constant-time AES (src/crypto/aes.cpp over src/crypto/ctaes). Shipped in the binary; no production call path found in the node itself (the wallet uses the AES-256 variant of the same code). Presence of the algorithm in the shipped library is what this records — 128-bit key leaves a ~64-bit margin under Grover, below CNSA 2.0 preference but not broken.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2-SHA256 (HMAC-SHA256 inner) is the core component of scrypt, which is Dogecoin's proof-of-work hash (80-byte block-header input, scrypt N/r/p parameters). The single iteration (c=1) is the scrypt specification: strength comes from memory hardness, not iteration count. Not used for password storage anywhere in this tree.
